# Arcturus Professional Services

Arcturus Professional Services is the independent solo freelance practice of Khushboo Tomar. It is not an agency and it is not based in the UK or Ireland. Khushboo is based in New Delhi, India and works directly with businesses in Ireland, the United Kingdom and wider Europe. All communication is in writing by email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn. Phone calls and call-booking appointments are not offered.

## Services (all prices in EUR)

- LinkedIn Management: profile optimisation, targeted outreach, follow-ups and written reporting. EUR 250 per month for outreach, or EUR 450 per month with one post every day (text, image or short AI video). https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/linkedin-management
- B2B Email Outreach: GDPR and PECR-aware cold email campaigns with a one-month domain warm-up, follow-ups and reporting. EUR 450 per month, sending (Instantly) and warm-up (Mailivery) tools included; leads are separate. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-outreach
- Business Support: remote research, administration, documents, website support and AI-assisted content. EUR 16 per hour, billed on actual time. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/business-support
- Lead Generation: verified B2B contact research by company size, role, industry and location. EUR 0.09 per verified lead, minimum order 1,000 leads (EUR 90). https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/lead-generation
- Email Setup: email delivery setup on the client's existing domain and mailbox, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC. EUR 75 one-time per domain. https://arcturusprofessional.com/services/email-setup

## Payment

50% in advance before work starts, remaining 50% on delivery. Monthly services: 50% at the start and 50% at the end of each month. Payments via Wise. Third-party subscriptions (Sales Navigator, Hootsuite, domains, email accounts) are paid by the client.
